integrity: The graph and face definition is exhaustive; all finite matching, Lefschetz and persistence checks use bundled standalone standard-library code. No external or independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for GP(7,2), higher-independence cutoffs 1 through 4; 4-stage persistence only; rational rather than integral representation characters; no later-cutoff persistence, general-family theorem or integral image-index assertion.
title: Equivariant higher-independence topology and persistence of \(GP(7,2)\)
